# The Delver

*Blind, as big as a cart and armed with digging claws, the thing that has been scratching under the Old Quarter waits in its burrow behind the Royal Vault's deepest corridor. Potions work in there; scrolls do not.*

|  |  |
|---|---|
| Boss | [The Delver](../monsters/delver.md) |
| Arena | [The Delver's Burrow](../maps/delvers_burrow.md) |

- Unlocked by [Digging Behind the Vault](../quests/wulfric_digging_behind_the_vault.md)
- Entered by talking to [Ida](../npcs/ida.md)
